_comment: Clinical follow-up questions tailored to reported symptoms, duration, and patient parameters.

clinical_questions.question: How severe is your fever?
clinical_questions.relevance: Differentiates mild viral upper respiratory illnesses from high-inflammatory viral syndromes or bacteremia.

clinical_questions.question: How long have you experienced these symptoms?
clinical_questions.relevance: Crucial temporal marker to distinguish acute infections from subacute or chronic diseases (e.g. COPD, IBS, Hypothyroidism).

clinical_questions.question: What does your cough feel like?

options.label: Contains streaks of blood or rust colored

clinical_questions.relevance: Distinguishes upper viral cough/asthma from lower airway alveolar exudative processes (pneumonia, bronchitis) and red-flag hemoptysis.

clinical_questions.question: Have you had any known exposure or travel?

options.label: Close contact with someone who has flu/COVID or similar illness
Recent travel to tropical / mosquito-prone regions (within 2 weeks)

clinical_questions.relevance: Increases epidemiological prior probability for specific vector-borne or airborne infections.
